violations.why: The ISR can increment global_var between main's two reads used as the array index, so the write at line 32 and the read at line 34 use different indices.
When i==2, main writes array[2] at line 38. The ISR can then overwrite it at line 47 before main reads it at line 42, so main reads the ISR's value rather than the one it wrote.
